parameters.name: Domains
parameters.description:
The domain names of the websites. You can specify up to five domain names.

> A website forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. Call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro instance belongs in Resource Management. If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.
